            Review guidelines

            Community guidelines

            Be respectful and specific. Reviews must be about the product and your own experience. We remove reviews with personal information, offensive language, links or spam.

            What makes a helpful review
            • Mention how you used it (trail type, weather, distance).
            • Describe fit compared to your usual size.
            • Share what you liked and what could be better.
            Photo quality tips
            • Use daylight and show the boot from the side.
            • Include a close-up of any wear or defects.
            • Avoid faces and other people in photos.
            Policy on incentivized reviews

            We never pay for reviews or remove negative ones. Reviews written in exchange for free products are labeled "Incentivized" and excluded from the average rating.
